guard.note: processUnloads: chunksToUnload.removeIf(lambda$processUnloads$10), the one walk of the set (wrapped, require = 0: a mod that replaces the method without that call keeps its own loop)
the walk's predicate: chunkVisibility.get(key) != HIDDEN -> true (drop the key), else processChunkUnload(key)

updateChunkStatus: HIDDEN -> chunkVisibility.remove + chunksToUnload.add, else chunkVisibility.put + chunksToUnload.remove + ensureChunkQueuedForLoad; then the section status pass (the add / remove wrapped)
processChunkUnload: storeChunkSections(key, unloadEntity of every passenger and self) -> chunkLoadStatuses.remove; the entity unloads that run listener code during the walk

vanilla_entity_unload_snapshot.conversion: MixinExtras @WrapOperation on chunksToUnload.removeIf in processUnloads (processUnloads()V: the stock call inside a deferral scope; require = 0) and on chunksToUnload.add / remove in updateChunkStatus(ChunkPos, Visibility) (queued while the scope is open, applied in order when it closes); priority 1500 so the wrap is let into a replacement of processUnloads (C2ME 0.4.0-alpha.0.122's chunk system replaces it at priority 1100 with a loop that pops keys off a LongLinkedOpenHashSet and has no removeIf: the wrap finds nothing there and the switch leaves that loop to C2ME)
